adjudication: Authority and identity: the post's actor is the company page itself (feed-actor-name link br.linkedin.com/company/odata, 'ODATA - An Aligned Data Centers Company', 110,643 followers at capture). It is not a reshare or an employee post. It names DC SP04, Osasco and 'Fase 2 de seu projeto de expansão', which the Atlas renders as 'Phase 2 Expansion'. Identity binding to the named project is direct.

Physical character: 'site mobilization' here is on-site physical activity, not planning. ODATA calls it a stage of the construction works ('obra'), says the teams are receiving materials and permanent plant (chillers, generators) on site, and attaches a video of the works. It is not a permit, budget, procurement contract or forecast. The sentence about seven generators supporting 24 MW of Phase 2 environments ('serão') is prospective and creates no observation or capacity.

Stage: site mobilization is the earliest construction stage. The narrowest Atlas value would be site_preparation; the selected under_construction is the broader construction-family value. The pre-registration records intra-construction stage differences without counting them, and the core already admits narrow site_preparation rows. This is not a contract failure and needs no baseline correction.

Date: the LinkedIn activity identifier encodes 2026-06-18T14:14:33.254Z (7473377620018077696 >> 22 = 1781792073254 ms). The post video's cover asset encodes 2026-06-18T14:14:19.901Z. The page showed '1mo' when captured on 2026-07-21, and The Tech Capital reported the start of the second-phase stage on 2026-06-23. The observation is 27 days inside the window and 63 days before the reference date.

Successors: no authoritative completion or cancellation was found on or before 2026-08-20. The bodies of ODATA's two in-window site posts (2026-06-09, 2026-07-21) and of Aligned's 14 in-window posts do not mention SP04 or Osasco. The 2026-09-17 ODATA/Aligned DeltaFlow release, and ODATA's matching LinkedIn post in the 2026-09-26 Wayback snapshot, say phase-one DeltaFlow installation and testing are underway at SP04: work still in progress after the window. These neither name Phase 2 nor refresh the date.

Non-dispositive items: ODATA's media library holds an aerial photo of the SP04 campus uploaded on 2026-08-17. The photo is undated, shows the finished building, substation and generator yard, cannot show in-building fit-out, and makes no completion statement. The 2026-10-01 NeoFeed interview says part of ODATA's projects were frozen during the Redata delay, but names no SP04 project, and the CEO adds 'Nós nunca chegamos a represar projetos'. A third-party directory search result (dcatlas.io, not captured) labelling SP04 '48 MW live' is undated and not authoritative.

Locator: the Atlas used the place-pin terminal tokens, not the map viewport centre (@-23.483217,-46.7785784, 262.6 m west). The retained 2026-07-21 bytes and Aligned's map_locations/8616 (modified 2026-01-26) give the same point and street address. The old facility URL now redirects to odatadc.com/localidades/; that does not affect an as-of locator.

Disagreement cause: the reviewer's WebSearch budget ran out at its first query, and LinkedIn was not searched. The only first-party in-window source is a post on a host whose robots.txt disallows all generic agents, and no Internet Archive copy of it exists. A robots-compliant blind reviewer could therefore reach it only through search results or secondary press. The ODATA and Aligned sites the reviewer read contain no in-window SP04 item, as this review confirms. The one in-window trade item found here (The Tech Capital) was not among the outlets the reviewer searched. This is not an Atlas error in status, date, identity or location.

capture_and_rights.method: Credential-free single-shot Node fetches (capture.mjs): no retry, no overwrite, content-decoded bytes, user agent identifying the Atlas project. Robots.txt was read before every host was used. No LinkedIn page was fetched; LinkedIn was read only through its robots.txt and Internet Archive copies. No CAPTCHA, login, registration wall or bot challenge was bypassed.
capture_and_rights.redistribution: Compact attributed facts, short literal pointers and hashes only. Raw HTML, JSON, images, video and headers stay in ignored tmp/ and local_data/ and are not redistributed.
capture_and_rights.personal_data: None projected. The NeoFeed interview names the ODATA CEO and the Tech Capital byline names its editor; neither is used as a claim.

next_evidence_needed: None for admission. Should the robots disclosure be treated as disqualifying, the cure is a robots-compliant copy of the same first-party post, or another authoritative in-window SP04 Phase 2 physical observation (for example an Osasco works licence, a CETESB record or a contractor update), followed by a fresh completion and cancellation screen.
